display_long_description:
# The Ultimate Welcome To VR Experience
**Your next gen plank walking simulator**, set high up in ultra realistic New York City and now London's Big Ben. It's the perfect first experience to show off your new headset! 
[media]
Bring friends and family together for great laughs as everyone’s knees go weak on a thin plank atop the One Astor Plaza skyscraper and Big Ben!
[media]
# Next Gen Realism
We set out to push the limits of what the most realistic plank simulator could be on next gen Quest hardware.
[media]
# Plank Variety
6 plank variations including: Wood Plank, Glass Plank, Metal Grate, The Pole, Red Light Green Light and Roulette. More to come!
[media]
# Three Environments Included and Counting!
Welcome London to the party!
[media]
# Health and Safety Warning
All users must refer to the in-game EULA and Safety Guidelines to limit the risk of injury or harm when walking the virtual plank.
